title: Toy Boat
subtitle: Diphthongs OI & OA
description: This exercise drills the OI /ɔɪ/ and OA /oʊ/ vowel diphthongs, which require a smooth glide between two vowel positions. Mixing them in rapid alternation is one of the most notoriously difficult English tongue challenges.
tip: A diphthong is a glide — start at the first vowel and smoothly slide to the second. For OI, glide from /ɔ/ to /ɪ/. For OA, glide from /o/ to /ʊ/. Never stop in the middle.
phrases: Toy boat, toy boat, toy boat.
The boy's voice annoyed the loyal coin collector.
The goat in the boat floated past the coast.
Roy's loyal boy enjoyed the moist soil in the royal garden.
A slow old crow flew over the low stone road.
The noisy oil-soaked boy pointed at the poised foil boat.
